letter_markdown:
Skyler Mercado  
Member ID: W472934846  
Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield  
Connecticut Commercial/ACA Plan  

Date: August 15, 2026  

Re: Internal appeal of denial for partial knee replacement  
CPT 27446  
Reference number: POC-0731BE4A81-34362  

To Anthem Appeals,

I am appealing Anthem’s denial of prior authorization for partial knee replacement, CPT 27446. The denial states that the imaging findings submitted do not support medical necessity. I respectfully request that Anthem reverse the denial and authorize the procedure.

The submitted medical records document severe, isolated medial-compartment knee disease:

- The June 3, 2026 MRI shows full-thickness cartilage loss in the medial compartment with bone-on-bone apposition.
- The medial compartment is documented as Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4.
- Examination shows positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.
- I have experienced 14 months of progressive knee pain that has not been relieved by rest.
- The pain substantially limits function. I cannot climb stairs without assistance and wake three to four times each night because of pain.

The records also show unsuccessful conservative treatment:

- I completed 24 supervised physical therapy visits over 16 weeks, from March 17, 2026 through July 7, 2026, with treatment focused on quadriceps strengthening and range of motion. The therapy course and outcome are documented in the physical therapy discharge note.
- I used NSAIDs for four months without adequate relief.
- A corticosteroid injection on May 8, 2026 provided only four weeks of partial relief.

The imaging is not merely suggestive of mild or early disease. It documents complete cartilage loss, bone-on-bone contact, and grade 4 medial-compartment degeneration. These findings correspond to the affected compartment and support the requested partial knee replacement. The clinical records also demonstrate persistent pain, objective examination abnormalities, substantial functional impairment, and failure of an appropriate course of nonoperative treatment.

The submitted records further document that I have no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and that I am a non-smoker. These facts do not identify a clinical reason to deny the requested procedure.

I also request that Anthem provide the exact medical-necessity criteria applied to this determination, including the specific policy or clinical utilization-management guideline, its title and number, version or effective date, and the imaging requirement used in reviewing CPT 27446. I was unable to identify a publicly available Anthem document containing the criteria applied to this partial knee replacement request. Anthem’s publicly available provider-policy information indicates that some utilization-management criteria may be proprietary, so please include the applicable criteria and the clinical-review rationale in the appeal file.

Please have the request reviewed by a qualified clinician with appropriate expertise in orthopedic surgery or musculoskeletal medicine. Please consider the complete prior authorization record, including the June 3, 2026 MRI, physical therapy discharge note, medication history, injection history, examination findings, and functional limitations.

For these reasons, I request reversal of the denial and authorization of partial knee replacement, CPT 27446.

Sincerely,

Skyler Mercado  
Member ID: W472934846  
Reference number: POC-0731BE4A81-34362
